title: Rivet-Quota Keeper
text: Rivet-Quota Keeper counts every worked fastener and claims living hands when the construction quota falls short. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: The missing rivet must be replaced with something.

defeatReward.text: Rivet-Quota Keeper is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
